BiblicalUsage: Zoh is another Hebrew word for 'this' — shorter, sharper, the word that points and says this one here. Ahijah uses it when Jeroboam's wife comes in disguise, 'this' is the message she will carry home; Ecclesiastes uses it for laughter and mirth, 'this' is what they amount to. It is the pointing finger of the language.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that 'this' keeps Scripture honest — it points at the real message, the real folly, the real promise, and will not let us look away.
